Install Shizuku (free, open source). It lets Pol start its small audio helper with the access Android requires for call audio.

Allow Pol in Shizuku. The helper only carries call audio; it can\'t do anything else.
Ready. Answer on your iPhone or Android client and talk there, in HD (Opus wideband) when the call allows it.
Shizuku isn\'t running. Open it and start it with Wireless debugging (needed again after every restart), then come back.

One-time setup: Settings › About phone › tap Build number 7 times › Developer options › Wireless debugging (Wi-Fi must be on; no internet is used). Then start Shizuku. Works where the phone\'s audio system allows call audio interception; tested phones are listed in docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.

Place calls, answer, decline and end them from your other device. To talk there too, turn on call audio below.
Show this phone\'s contact names and numbers on your paired devices. Off by default.
Read and send texts from your other device. Recent 90 days are shared when it connects.
Show this phone\'s call history on your paired devices, and the caller\'s number for incoming calls.
Run codes such as a balance check (*140#) or call forwarding on either SIM. Results depend on your carrier.

Make Pol this phone\'s phone app, so paired devices can hold and resume calls, switch between two calls, send keypad tones and see exactly when a call is answered. You can switch back any time in Settings › Default apps.
On: Pol is this phone\'s phone app. Hold, swap and keypad tones work from your other devices.
Without Bluetooth permission your devices can\'t connect to this phone.
Your paired devices can use this phone\'s SIM cards over Bluetooth.
Turn on to let your paired devices use this phone\'s SIMs.
Open pairing for 3 minutes, then choose “Pair with gateway” on your iPhone or other Android phone.
Open Pol to compare the code.
On your other device, choose “Pair with gateway”. You\'ll compare a 6-digit code on both screens.
Pairing didn\'t complete. Open pairing again to retry.
Nothing leaves this phone except to the devices listed above, over an encrypted Bluetooth link. This app has no internet permission, no accounts and no analytics. This phone\'s fingerprint: %1$s
It will be disconnected now and can\'t reconnect unless you pair it again.
All paired devices are removed, this phone\'s identity key is deleted and features are turned off.
Use this phone as a gateway

Without system access an Android app can\'t put a cellular call on hold, or change APN, VoLTE, preferred network, SIM PIN or hotspot settings, so Pol doesn\'t offer them. Call audio needs the helper set up above.

No account, no server, no internet access. Your data moves only between your own paired phones over encrypted Bluetooth.

Keep both phones close and compare the 6-digit code.

Use the SIM cards in your Android gateway phone from this phone: calls, texts, recent calls and contacts, over an encrypted Bluetooth link.
